text:
scenario + harsh reality + divine design

>Friendship, where friend and his lady break up
>You tell him how you really feel, "she was wrong for you, no good" + red flags
>...They get back together

friendship is over at this point

he knows u don't approve + will tell her everything

bigger issue is on character:
>if she was the one who broke it off, and he chased her down and went begging... no good + she loses all respect for him.
>if he broke it off - "its over" - and then went back on his word...no good + she loses all respect for him.

entire decision tree is busted

soon as it surfaces that ur word is no good, everything collapses -- self-respect first, derivatives of self-respect second (relationships, both friendship & love)

prob takes 15-20 years of watching this fact pattern repeat, to lay it down as law

and to recognize that the only respectable endgame, is to take L's with dignity and grace, no matter what side of the table ur on.

u learn dignity, grace, and self-respect only thru losing them

and u learn that if u made the wrong decision in walking away, u live with that decision.

because the only alternative is to turn around, sacrificing all dignity, grace, and self-respect while betraying yourself in the process.

when u go back on ur word, you become "revealed to yourself" as someone who doesn't uphold the silent promises he makes.

all downhill from there. all part of the divine design. just one of those internal punishments inflicted by God, factory-installed in the soul, where a man becomes his own worst enemy...realizing why Dante's 9th layer, pure ice, was reserved for betrayal.

every external punishment of hell sounds preferable to the one u endure

when there is no quiet, no peace, and ur worst nightmare... is to be all alone with your thoughts.

Paradise Lost: "The mind is its own place, and can make a heaven of hell, a hell of heaven."

quotedTweet.text:
v important life skill

when someone walks out that door…friend, lover, whoever

lock it and don’t ever look back

hold no resentment or grudges. understand what they mean by “LEARN TO LOVE PEOPLE FROM A DISTANCE.”

until u master this, u will never know dignity or self-respect
